body:
Mixed-kernel expansion drops a while carry when it is used only by the condition and its final result is unused. Polling loops then lose their initial read and backedge update, leaving `ready__FREE_VAR` for PTO codegen.

Seed loop-state liveness from the while condition before propagating yield dependencies, and check that pruning leaves no dropped carry in the condition or surviving yields. Add scalar/tile polling regressions, FIFO dependency and dead-slot coverage, CPU codegen controls, and matching English/Chinese pass documentation.

Validation: worktree-local CMake build, 469 related Python pass/codegen tests, and both native CTest tests pass. Formatting, lint, type checking, source-header checks, and documentation checks pass. GitHub CI runs independently on this PR.

Fixes #3009
